lines.t: I've been walking with a heart unsure Trying hard to keep my trust secure
Every prayer I whispered in the night Felt like it was drifting out of sight
But you were steady in the quiet air
Holding every hope and every fear
I didn't see you working in the dust
But you were teaching me to wait and trust
And I know I still get lost sometimes
But you pull me back with your gentle light
What if it's you, what if it's always been your love breaking through
What if the moments that I call the ending were leading me straight into something
What if you're here, closer than breath and loud in all of my fears
What if the hope I've been chasing forever was you drawing near
I've been holding to my own design
Trying to outrun the changing tides
But every road I built on shifting sand
Just brought me back to your open hands
And now I'm learning how to stand again
Letting go of battles I can't win
You take the ashes that I thought were lost
And write a story with the weight of the cross
And I know I still get scared sometimes
But your perfect love is still right
What if it's you, what if it's always been your love breaking through
What if the moments that I called the ending were leading me straight into something new
What if you're here, closer than breath and louder than all of my fears
What if the hope I've been chasing forever was you drawing me
What if it's you?
When I doubt, when I'm overwhelmed
Lord, remind my wandering heart
You are with me still
Never fail, never walk away
Even when I lose my faith, you stay
What if it's you?
What if it's always been your love breaking through?
What if the waiting and the wonder in wilderness
Was bringing me home to the truth?
What if you're here?
Closer than breath and louder than every fear
What if the hope I've been chasing forever
Was you drawing me in
What if it's you
What if it's you
